name: io.github.partnerhbhl/firekey-mcp
title: FireKey MCP
description: Manage FireKey browser profiles and browser lifecycles through an authenticated localhost API.

environmentVariables.name: FIREKEY_API_KEY

environmentVariables.name: FIREKEY_PORT
